{{Quote|They are traditionalists&mdash;tonsorially as well as politically. The style of dress and facial adornments pay homage to the regalia of Queen Elsinore ''[sic]'' den Tasia of Grizmallt, who dispatched an expeditionary fleet of humans to the planet some four thousand years ago, and to whom some Naboo claim to be able to trace an unbroken ancestry.|Larsh Hill, on the Naboo|audio=Tonsorially.flac|<ref name="Darth">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Grizmallt''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] called the [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]]. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]] began her reign of Grizmallt around [[3950 BBY]], launching an era of [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]]. Although many of the expeditions failed, Grizmallti colonists populated various planets around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including eight in the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]] and the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. Around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], Grizmallt was engulfed in a [[Grizmallti civil war/Legends|civil war]], and Tasia sponsored a final expedition of refugees that resulted in the Human colonization of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

In the final [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Grizmallt held one of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] largest [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] facilities, and after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the [[Commissars of Grizmallt/Legends|Commissars of Grizmallt]] commenced operations to bolster their competition with [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. At some point between [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of Naboo paid a state visit to Grizmallt. Binks created a famous gaffe due to the differences between the [[Royal Script of Grizmallt]] and the Naboo [[Futhark/Legends|Futhark]], which had evolved from the former [[Writing/Legends|writing system]]. Grizmallt was later an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]], but in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] the planet surrendered to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]].

==Description==
Grizmallt was a terrestrial<ref name="Written" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Grizmallt system/Legends|Grizmallt system]]. It lay on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Alsakan system/Legends|Alsakan]] and [[Axum system]]s while also serving as a dividing line between the regions known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]&mdash;more specifically, the [[Arrowhead]].<ref name="TEA" /> A rare [[Species/Legends|subspecies]]<ref name="Aliens" /> called the [[Grizmallt nerf]]<ref name="Nerf DB">{{DB|creature|nerf|nerf}}</ref> was reportedly found there, which had little connection to other examples of the [[Nerf/Legends|same species]],<ref name="Aliens" /> being taller and slimmer.<ref name="Nerf DB" /> It was speculated that their differences in neck length and body shape with common nerfs were the result of [[Millennium|millennia]] of reaching for leaves and [[Berry/Legends|berries]] on high [[Tree/Legends|tree]] limbs.<ref name="Aliens" />

==History==
===Alsakan Conflicts and colonial expansion===
[[File:Kes-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|300px|During the Alsakan Conflicts, Grizmallt was aligned with the world Alsakan in its struggle against the Galactic Republic's capital planet Coruscant.]]
During the early phase of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of wars between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the world [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies that [[First Alsakan Conflict|erupted]] around [[17,018 BBY]], Grizmallt was aligned with Alsakan.<ref name="Warfare" /> At one point, the [[Grizmallti/Legends|Grizmallti]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]]<ref name="CSWE Grizmallt" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet<ref name="Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]],<ref name="CSWE Grizmallt" /> which eventually became a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony under the [[Grissmath Dynasty]].<ref name="Planets and Moons" /> Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the Grizmallti discovered a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet<ref name="Nexus" /> in the southern [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Southern quadrant|quadrant]]<ref name="GB" /> which they named [[Naboo/Legends|Nabu]], in reference to one of their principal [[Nabu/Legends|deities]]. Grizmallti [[Noble/Legends|aristocrats]] used Nabu as a vacation spot, causing the world's [[Homeworld/Legends|natives]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], to withdraw into the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] to avoid the newcomers.<ref name="Nexus" />

Around [[3950 BBY]], [[Elsinoré den Tasia]] became [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of Grizmallt and ushered in a new age of exploration and colonization.<ref name="GB" /> During Tasia's reign, the [[Palazzo Reina]] was built, and writing inside it used the [[Royal Script of Grizmallt]], an oval-based [[Writing/Legends|writing system]].<ref name="Written" /> In 3950 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Tasia sponsored the colonization of the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]],<ref name="TEA" /> which led to the settlement of eight planets there, although they became isolated from the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Renatasia">{{CSWECite|III|92|Renatasia system}}</ref> While many worlds were colonized by the Grizmallti,<ref name="CSWE Grizmallt" /> most of Grizmallt's colonization efforts failed as [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] became destroyed or lost,<ref name="GB" /> and the planet was engulfed in a [[Grizmallti civil war/Legends|civil war]]<ref name="Nexus" /> around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]].<ref name="GB" />

===Colonization of Naboo===
{{Quote|At approximately 3900 BBY, Queen Tasia of Grizmallt sponsored one of the last of her world's colonization missions.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC" />}}
[[File:Naboo_planet.png|thumb|left|300px|Humans from Grizmallt colonized Naboo (pictured).]]
Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Death/Legends|dying]] Queen Tasia sponsored a final expedition, which set out toward the southern galactic quadrant. The expedition was populated by [[Currency/Legends|fortune]] and glory-seeking<ref name="GB" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] Grizmallti refugees<ref name="Nexus" /> aboard three colony [[Starship/Legends|ships]],<ref name="TEA" /> the ''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'' and its support [[Starship/Legends|starships]], ''[[Constant]]'' and ''[[Mother Vima]]''. It was blessed by a [[Unidentified famous Jedi Master|famous Jedi Master]]<ref name="GB" /> and led by the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]].<ref name="Secrets">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> After they departed Grizmallt, Tasia passed away, hoping for the expedition to land safely in her final moments. Contact with the ''Beneficent Tasia'' was lost shortly afterward and the Grizmallti assumed that the ships had been lost, but they had only been damaged and were unable to make contact due to the hazards of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="GB" />

Much later it was learned that the expedition had survived and that<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the refugees had colonized Nabu. The planet's name was later changed to Naboo, and the descendants of the colonists became known as the eponymous [[Naboo (people)|Naboo people]],<ref name="Nexus" /> who developed a handwritten script called [[Futhark/Legends|Futhark]] based on the Royal Script of Grizmallt.<ref name="Written" /> A symbol related to Grizmallt also became the symbol of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="TOR date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/2|here]], Act II of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which includes the mission "A Farewell to Arms," takes place around [[3642 BBY]].</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] had the best [[Unidentified Grizmallt surgeon|surgeon]] on Grizmallt surgically turn his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] [[Color/Legends|gold]], claiming it to be a million-[[Credit chip/Legends|credit]] job.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|A Farewell to Arms|Balmorra}}</ref>

===Twilight of the Republic===
{{Quote|Rather than sniff out conspiracy in every corner, I think this is just a political save-face maneuver. After the embarrassment of last week's plea to Dooku, I think Palpatine's finally getting some real direction by turning to those more proactive than he.|Senator Tashrikam of Grizmallt in a HoloNet News report|<ref name="Holonet" />}}
[[File:Naboo.svg|thumb|right|250px|The symbol (pictured) of the Royal House of Naboo was also associated with Grizmallt.]]
In the last [[Standard century/Legends|century]] of the Galactic Republic, Grizmallt was home to one of the galaxy's largest heavy [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] facilities, rivaled only by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili Stardrive]].<ref name="CSWE Grizmallt" /> The Naboo continued to honor the memory of Tasia thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after her death, with some individuals paying homage through their [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] style and facial adornments and claiming an unbroken ancestry to her. This fact was acknowledged by [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] financier [[Larsh Hill]] in a meeting on Naboo between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]].<ref name="Darth" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] of Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] wore dark purple robes decorated with a [[Naboo royal crest/Legends|symbol]] associated with Grizmallt.<ref name="TPM Expanded" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #49]] was published on 13:3:28, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Grizmallt was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tashrikam]]. Following [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] formation of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], a group intended to diplomatically address the growing threat of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Tashrikam referred to the committee as a political maneuver to save face while also stating that Palpatine was gaining direction by turning to more proactive senators. Tashrikam's statements were recorded in the 13:3:28 issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition]].<ref name="Holonet" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|While the two scripts are similar, small variances differentiate the Royal Script from the Naboo Futhark, a fact made eminently clear when Senator Binks of Naboo famously misinterpreted the name of the Palazzo's Heroine Hall as 'Hero in Hell' during Queen Apailana's state visit to the world.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, on the Royal Script of Grizmallt in "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written" />}}
[[File:Jar_Jar_aotc.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Senator Jar Jar Binks participated in a state visit to Grizmallt, where he made a famous gaffe.]]
Later that year, tensions between the Republic and the Separatists erupted into the galaxy-wide [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], which saw a Republic victory thanks to the appearance of the new [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that utilized [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] designed by Kuat Drive Yards. Shortly afterward, the [[Commissars of Grizmallt/Legends|Commissars of Grizmallt]] ordered industrial [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and starship designers to reduce Kuat Drive Yards' competitive lead in securing new contracts for military vessels.<ref name="Cross">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Fact">{{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1-2|Moralo Eval}} places the events of "[[Crisis on Naboo]]" in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] was held on Naboo in commemoration of the planet joining the Republic, and part of the celebration included a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] display of one of the Grizmallti colony ships.<ref name="Clone Wars guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep418|text="Crisis on Naboo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Between 21 BBY and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Bigdate">[[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana's]] reign began after that of Queen [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]], who was in power during the events of "[[Crisis on Naboo]]," which took place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] according to {{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1-2|Moralo Eval}}, and ended with her [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] according to {{Blog|holocron|22/comments|Movie Characters killed in the EU}}</ref> Queen [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]]<ref name="Written" /> of Naboo<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|queenapailana|Apailana, Queen}}</ref> paid a state visit to Grizmallt along with<ref name="Written" /> Gungan<ref name="NEC" /> senator [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Apailana and Binks visited the Palazzo Reina, where the senator created a famous incident by misreading the name of the building's [[Heroine Hall]] as "Hero in Hell" due to the slight variances between the Royal Script of Grizmallt and Naboo Futhark.<ref name="Written" />

===Empire and New Republic===
{{Quote|At last. All right, I can tell you now: I've finally delivered the secret formula for new improved Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor! 'If it's Grizmallt, it slips down your throat.' The local bottling operation thanks you!|An individual to a spacer who helped escort them to safety|<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=general|Hyper-Dangerous Mission|various planets}}</ref>}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="NEC" /> under which Grizmallt became a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]].<ref name="DESB" /> Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], fought between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Unidentified individual (Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor)|individual]] developed a secret formula for [[Slipthroat Grizmallt Liquor]] and undertook a long trip to deliver it, with all of their companions dying in the process.<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Near the end of their journey, the individual encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and asked them&mdash;without revealing what they were carrying&mdash;for assistance in getting to their destination. After the spacer agreed and escorted them to safety, the individual revealed to the spacer that they carried the secret formula.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:AdmiralAck.png|thumb|right|250px|Grizmallt surrendered to the fleet of Admiral Gial Ackbar.]]
Later in the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance transitioned into the New Republic and [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] Coruscant<ref name="DESB" /> in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Alongside Alsakan, [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]], and many other worlds, Grizmallt surrendered to the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]<ref name="DESB" /> with little resistance.<ref name="CSWE Grizmallt" /> Following the [[Swarm War]] in [[36 ABY]], Grizmallt was acknowledged in several academic texts. The existence of the nerf subspecies on Grizmallt was reported in [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], which was compiled from the notes of [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="Aliens" /> The planet's role in the colonization of Naboo was recorded in a [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|document]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]],<ref name="NEC" /> and the link between the Royal Script of Grizmallt and Naboo Futhark, along with the events of Binks' visit, was documented by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]] in the academic text "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]" in [[38 ABY]].<ref name="Written" />

==Inhabitants==
Grizmallt was a heavily populated world,<ref name="CSWE Grizmallt" /> inhabited by Humans called the Grizmallti,<ref name="Nexus" /> who utilized a writing system called the Royal Script of Grizmallt.<ref name="Written" /> The planet had a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchial]] government under Queen Tasia<ref name="GB" /> and was represented in the Galactic Senate around the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="Holonet" /> The commissars of Grizmallt were a group active around the time of the Clone Wars, playing a role in coordinating starship designs for the Republic.<ref name="Cross" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|There, the Royal Script still graces the Palazzo Reina and other buildings dating to the rule of Queen Tasia, and is used on street signs in the capital's Old Quarter.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, on Grizmallt in "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written" />}}
Grizmallt contained one of the galaxy's largest heavy engineering facilities.<ref name="CSWE Grizmallt" /> During Tasia's reign, the Palazzo Reina was constructed, containing Heroine Hall. The capital of Grizmallt had an [[Old Quarter (Grizmallt)|Old Quarter]], which, like the Palazzo Reina and other buildings from Tasia's reign, had signage written in the Royal Script of Grizmallt.<ref name="Written" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Jar-Jar's ''[sic]'' 'diplomatic incident' with Queen Apailana during her state visit to Grizmallt seemed a good way to hint at the orthographic drift between the Naboo and their forebears, and to have a little fun with a certain klutzy Gungan, of whom we've seen so little in the post-RotS timeframe.|John Hazlett, in the endnotes for "The Written Word"|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|JSarek|8|Endnotes for The Written Word}}</ref>}}
[[File:Dark_Empire_Sourcebook.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Grizmallt was first mentioned in the ''Dark Empire Sourcebook''.]]
Grizmallt was first mentioned in the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1993]].<ref name="DESB" /> In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided Quick Reference Guide]]'', published in [[2003]] as a companion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the planet's name was mispelled as "Grizmalit,"<ref name="Galaxies Quick">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided Quick Reference Guide]]''</ref> an error repeated in later guides for the game and its expansions.<ref name="Galaxies Jump">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref><ref name="Total">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Grizmallt in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" /> In his [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[The Written Word]]," published on [[March 5]], [[2010]],<ref name="Pub date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30796355|board=Literature|thread=Hyperspace New Short Fiction: JJM's "The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol" now online!!!|user=[[Nathan O'Keefe|Valin_Kenobi]]|date=2010-03-05|time=12:25 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171006225114/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/hyperspace-new-short-fiction-jjms-the-secret-journal-of-doctor-demagol-now-online.28297369/page-16}}</ref> author [[John Hazlett]] drew from a reference to Grizmallt made in<ref name="Endnotes" /> the [[2005]]<ref name="NEC" /> reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to hint at the idea of the changing of [[Language/Legends|language]] between Grizmallt and Naboo over time, while also creating a "fun" incident with the character Jar Jar Binks.<ref name="Endnotes" />
